changelog:
Version 7.8.92

Improved

  • "Check again" on the Updates screen now always looks for a new plugin release, and an available update is shown even when the WordPress.org update service does not answer.
  • A cached page served while it is being refreshed is now delivered without waiting for the refresh to start.
  • Applying Maximum or Auto now uses the plugin's fast page cache file automatically when the existing file was left behind by a plugin that is no longer active.

Fixed

  • If the plugin's generated file is removed, the page cache file stops serving pages and later moves itself aside, so another caching plugin can be used.
